description: Source file defining a SwiftUI view and associated model for system run settings, including agent selection, security policies, allowlist management, and UI bindings.

classes.name: SystemRunSettingsView
classes.description: SwiftUI view presenting system execution approval settings and allowlist management.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: Observable class managing the state and business logic for approval settings, agents, and allowlist entries.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistRow
classes.description: View representing a single allowlist entry with pattern editing and removal options.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistEntry
classes.description: Data model for an allowlist pattern entry, including metadata such as last used command and resolved path.

classes.name: ExecSecurity
classes.description: Enum representing different security control levels.

classes.name: ExecAsk
classes.description: Enum representing different prompt behavior modes.

classes.name: ExecApprovalHelpers
classes.description: Helper functions for validating and recognizing allowlist patterns.

classes.name: ExecApprovalQuickMode
classes.description: Model representing quick approval modes based on security and ask settings.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously reloads agent list and settings for the selected agent.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of agents from persistent store.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Selects an agent and reloads its specific settings.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads approval and allowlist settings for a specified agent.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates security level and persists change.

methods.name: setAsk
methods.description: Updates ask mode and persists change.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic skill CLI allowlisting and refreshes skill bins.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern after validation.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist entry with validation.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Fetches an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks if a pattern qualifies as a path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Refreshes the cached skill bins list, optionally forcing a refresh.
